name: Shri Harsh Vardhan Shringla
education: B.A. (Hons.) History, Course on Conflict Prevention Educated at St. Stephen’s College, University of Delhi and Columbia University, New York
profession: Diplomat, Civil Service, Social Worker and Management Consultant
present_address: C I/12A PANDARA PARK , NEW DELHI 110003
permanent_address: 4, Franklyn Prestage Road, Darjeeling, West Bengal 734101
books: International Paper on Conflict Prevention, in the Indian Journal of International Law; has authored numerous articles and columns published in reputed journals, leading newspapers and by prominent think tanks
social_activities: Founder-President, Darjeeling Welfare Society (D.W.S.), which promotes education, development of youth, women’s empowerment, and environmental conservation in North Bengal and the Northeast India; the DWS has a target of reaching sufficient market capitalisation for all self help groups; the society has provided computers, laptops, tablets, stationery, and sports kits to schools and students; has also provided medical support such as free distribution of hearing aids, diagnostic kits, water purifiers in the Darjeeling region, ration and clothing to senior citizens and underprivileged families and relief funds to landslide and flood victims in the region; has instituted the DWS Outstanding Achievement Award; launched a free UPSC coaching programme for underprivileged youth of the Darjeeling Hills in 2024; has also been organizing large-scale employment events; organized a career fair for school students; has spearheaded a range of impactful social and developmental initiatives in the Darjeeling hills; notable among these is the Darjeeling Livelihood Project, which was conceived with the vision of revitalizing closed tea gardens by providing vocational training, skill development, market linkages and supporting women self-help groups
hobbies: Takes strong interest in outdoor pursuits like mountaineering, trekking, and nature-based activities; an avid outdoorsman with mountaineering experience; a former hockey player at the university level
countries_visited: Thailand, Bangladesh and U.S.A., as India’s Ambassador/High Commissioner, in 2016, 2019 and 2022; Kuwait, Saudi Arabia, Bahrain, and Algeria, as part of the All-Party Parliamentary Delegation under India’s “Operation Sindoor” outreach, 23 May- 3 June, 2025
other_information: As Foreign Secretary, January 2020 - April 2022, dealt with complex diplomatic challenges including the India-China border conflict, 2020, U.S. withdrawal from Afghanistan and its implications for India, the Russia-Ukraine conflict, and the internal situation in Myanmar; played a pivotal role in coordinating major humanitarian relief and evacuation operations, including Operation Vande Bharat and Operation Ganga; as Chief Coordinator of India’s G20 Presidency, worked to transform the G20 from an event into a mass movement through the innovative ‘Janbhagidari’ initiative; as Ambassador to the United States, deepened foreign and defence cooperation through the 2+2 Ministerial Dialogue, strengthened Indo-Pacific engagement; his term has also been identified with the iconic ‘Howdy Modi’ and ‘Namaste Trump’ events in Houston and Ahmedabad, respectively; as High Commissioner to Bangladesh, played a key role in the conclusion of the historic India-Bangladesh Land and Maritime Boundary Agreements; launched the “Sonali Adhyay” (Golden Chapter) in bilateral relations; as Ambassador to Thailand, represented India at the United Nations Economic and Social Commission for Asia and the Pacific (UNESCAP); conferred, D.Litt. (Honoris Causa) by ICFAI University, Sikkim; recipient of, (i) Lifetime Achievement Award from Jaipur Foot, 2023, (ii) JT Gibson Award for Outstanding Alumni from his school, Mayo College; was inducted into the ‘Order of Illustrious Stephanians’ by his university alma mater, St Stephen’s College, Delhi University; a Viksit Bharat Distinguished Fellow; selected as the Robert Wilhelm Distinguished Fellow by MIT for 2025-26; passionate advocate for education and thought leadership; has addressed prestigious academic institutions and global think tanks; written extensively on themes including India’s diplomacy under Prime Minister Modi, the role of critical and emerging technologies, conflict resolution and regional cooperation; has announced that his MPLADS funds would be utilized for creating a sports multiplex for the youth of Darjeeling; has also spearheaded campaigns for environmental sustainability, including waste management programs and preservation of endangered species like the Himalayan salamander
